claim_text: Merck stated it was not aware of any beneficial owner above five percent; directors/officers as a group held 2,509,170 shares, less than 0.7%.
notes: Raw SEC text used because old proxy pack rendering is unreliable for this period.

claim_text: IBM disclosed director/officer common-stock voting and investment power; stock plus acquirable shares represented less than 1% and no individual exceeded 0.1%.
notes: No founder, family, or controlling shareholder signal found in reviewed proxy ownership table.

claim_text: P&G disclosed directors/officers held 0.709% of common stock; the ESOP Trust held 60.33% of Series A ESOP preferred stock, with voting directed by participants or proportionally by trustees.
notes: Classified as other-control signal because the material block is an ESOP preferred trust, not founder or family ownership.

claim_text: J&J disclosed each listed individual/group owned less than one percent, except co-trustee control of 5,218,864 shares without economic interest; aggregate owned/controlled shares were about 1%.
notes: No founder-control signal found in reviewed stock ownership/control section.

claim_text: Bristol-Myers Squibb disclosed voting securities and principal holders; all directors/officers as a group held 3,813,401 common shares, or 0.7%, and no directors/officers owned preferred stock.
notes: No founder, family, or controlling shareholder signal found in reviewed proxy ownership evidence.

claim_text: Pfizer disclosed no director or executive officer beneficially owned more than 0.13%; all directors and executive officers as a group owned shares and exercisable options totaling less than 1%.
notes: No founder-control signal found in reviewed security ownership of management section.

claim_text: Disney disclosed no beneficial owner above 5%; Roy E. Disney held 1.1%, and all current directors/officers as a group held 3.0%.
notes: EdgarPack current DIS maps to CIK 0001744489; 1997 proxy for predecessor CIK 0001001039 is used as the nearest available dominance-year proxy.

claim_text: PepsiCo disclosed one vote per share and no known beneficial owner above 5%; directors and executive officers as a group owned less than 1%.
notes: No founder-control signal found in reviewed proxy ownership evidence.

claim_text: Chevron disclosed director/officer beneficial ownership under SEC voting/investment power rules; all table amounts represented less than 1% of outstanding Chevron stock.
notes: No founder, family, or controlling shareholder signal found in reviewed proxy ownership section.

claim_text: AIG disclosed equity securities of AIG and its parents: M. R. Greenberg held 2.25% of AIG, and directors/officers as a group held 6.20% of AIG, 83.02% of Starr, and 81.82% of SICO.
notes: Classified as other-control signal because evidence is a private holding-company/parent network rather than founder-family voting control.

claim_text: Cisco disclosed no 5% shareholders based on 1996 13G review; John P. Morgridge held 1.55%, and all current officers/directors held 1.95%.
notes: Cisco founders were not visible in the reviewed 1996 proxy ownership table; row records professional-manager/dispersed control evidence.

claim_text: Lilly disclosed directors/officers as a group owned 0.114%; Lilly Endowment owned 16.959% with sole voting/investment power, and NCBI held 6.841% in fiduciary capacities.
notes: Classified as other-control signal; the SEC excerpt supports an Endowment block but does not by itself establish founder-family control.

claim_text: Fannie Mae disclosed that common stockholders elected 13 directors while the President of the United States appointed five directors; stock-ownership details were incorporated from the 1997 proxy statement.
notes: SEC/EdgarPack lists no 1995-1997 FNMA 10-K or proxy for CIK 0000310522. This nearest primary issuer Information Statement is used with an explicit availability limitation.

claim_text: Chase Manhattan disclosed post-merger beneficial ownership; directors/officers as a group held 2,807,354 shares and management holdings including acquisition rights represented less than 1%.
notes: 1996 cohort company maps to Chase Manhattan/JPMorgan Chase predecessor continuity; the 1996 Chase Manhattan proxy is used.
